---
title: "CS410 Advanced Functional Programming"
subtitle: "University of Strathclyde"
---

This class gives further skills in functional programming and an appreciation
of the mathematical structures that underpin general programming concepts and
techniques.

- Level: 4
- Credits: 20 (10 ECTS)
- Semester: 2
- Prerequisite: CS316 Functional Programming (recommended, not required)

See also:

- [Class catalogue entry](https://www.strath.ac.uk/studywithus/studyabroad/comingtostrathclyde/academicinformation/exchangeclasscatalogue/computerinformationsciences/)
- [Class description, 2026–27](https://local.cis.strath.ac.uk/wp/extras/syllabus/index.php?level=ug&year=2026&classid=1345)
